scope: Fixed seeds from actual Core native-version snapshots. Directed tests excluded. New royal registration, death proof and noble acts are new authoritative evidence; raw save hashes intentionally differ.

comparisonPolicy.historyBoundaries: HistoryIndex and eventIndex are event-count boundaries; remove only the added event types before the boundary to compare the same original transaction. No ordinary facts or events are removed from either actual save.
comparisonPolicy.existingDynastyProjection: Exclude only new registration and royalNobility fields.
comparisonPolicy.additionalReadOnlyPatch: Final living former-grantee label says 曾封 instead of 生前受封; no simulation effect.

performance.scope: Actual 4x Core twelve-month steps and real shared-tree React controls; three repeats per native saved world, baseline then candidate sequentially. User desktop may be active; timings are limited measurements, not visual acceptance or proof of whole-game speedup. JSON size is compact uncompressed UTF-8.

limitations: No supplied original Shen Xiao world: controlled real production case, not a claimed reproduction.
No natural old-country child officer sample; directed real Core and both shared React trees pass.
Royal hereditary chains are finite single-source chains. No automatic official appointment, noble recruitment bonus or new ordinary child population.
Native royal military secession/usurpation qualifications are unchanged; previously excluded native royals are not newly enabled to found foreign regimes.
Special royal honors and succession eligibility remain independent.
Command-line component/performance checks are not user Chrome/Electron visual acceptance.
